column1: # The CLIENT's per-kind GameAction EXECUTOR pair, dumped by tools/ghidra/DumpGameActionExecutors.java (#709).
# One C++ class per e_Type_GC_GameAction_* kind, each an 11-slot vtable whose slot 9 APPLIES the element to its
# target and slot 10 REMOVES it again. This says what an element MEANS, where docs/re/gameaction-keylists.tsv only
# says what its fields ARE; `apply`/`remove` are Ghidra FUN_ addresses in AgeOfConan.exe.
# `side` is the load-bearing column. `stub` means BOTH executors are a bare `return 1` - the client does nothing
# for that kind, so it is SERVER-authoritative (Hit, DPSHit, HitPercentage, BindAtLocation and
# TeleportToBindLocation are all stubs, which is the sanity check that the column reads the right way round).
# `client` means the client acts on the element itself, from its own RDB copy of the spell record, with no packet
#   TempChangeSkill  apply = SetStatOverride(statTable, key0 Stat, key39 Value); remove = ClearStatOverride
#                    - an OVERRIDE of the stat, not an addition to it.
#   PolyMorph        apply pushes (key799 BodyCatMesh, key761 Value, key796 Flags) into the character's
#                    PolyMorphHolder and runs UpdatePolyMorph, which sets MonsterData := BodyCatMesh and (unless
#                    Flags bit 1 / bit 0) HeadMesh := 0 and HairType := 1. See docs/rdb/spell-stat-effects.md.
# typeId joins docs/re/gameaction-type-ids.tsv and is EMPTY on the 14 classes whose name is absent from it.
